name: Elder Runetotem
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Runetotem appears outside Razor Hill in Durotar. The tauren spirit offers wisdom and a blessing to travelers who seek her.

sections.title: A Spirit in Durotar
sections.body: Elder Runetotem appears beside Razor Hill, far from the grassy plains and sacred burial grounds of Mulgore. Her presence brings the ancient traditions of the Shu'halo to the Horde's home along the Great Sea.

sections.title: Ancestral Honors
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits of great leaders, shamans, and heroes appear throughout the world to commune with the living. Elder Runetotem carries the name of a line that reveres the Earth Mother and seeks spiritual communion. Travelers who honor her receive ancestral tokens and her blessing.

aliases: who is the tauren ghost in razor hill
faq.answer: Elder Runetotem is a tauren ancestor who appears near Razor Hill in Durotar during the Lunar Festival. She greets travelers and offers ancestral blessings.

faq.q: Why is a tauren spirit located in Durotar?
aliases: why is runetotem in razor hill
faq.answer: Most tauren ancestral spirits are rooted in Mulgore, but the Lunar Festival spirits travel across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Her presence in Razor Hill lets Horde travelers passing through Durotar pay their respects to the wisdom of the Earth Mother's children.

faq.q: What connection does she have to the Runetotem tribe?
faq.answer: Elder Runetotem bears the name of the Runetotem clan, a prominent tauren lineage known for its shamans, spiritual guides, and ties to the natural world.

faq.q: What does speaking with her grant?
faq.answer: Speaking with Elder Runetotem during the Lunar Festival honors her memory and grants a Coin of Ancestry and a temporary blessing from the spirits.

angles.text: As a tauren, finding a venerable ancestor of the Runetotem tribe far from Mulgore reminds you that the spirits of the Shu'halo watch over their allies across all lands.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Elder Runetotem outside Razor Hill. Her presence reflects the spiritual alliance between the orcs of Durotar and the tauren of Mulgore.
